text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0836 CDT.
CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne lower on hot, dry Prairie weather and lower CBOT soycomplex calls. Technical support seen in the November at C$352, August at C$356.50.
November WCE canola crush profit margins fell to -3.24 Thursday from -2.81 Wednesday. Canada's dollar opened lower at C$1.3787, rose to 86.31 yen and rose to 1.3431 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.50 to C$1.00 down in readjustment of the Sep-Nov spread that ended at C$11.60 Thursday and may trade at C$11. September may open down as much as C$2 a tonne.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.20 to C$0.70 a tonne lower in correction of overbought status reached on Thursday.
FEED WHEAT - C$0.50 to C$1.00 down to correct for overbought close on Thursday.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
